explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/277 with Haight's positive answer: for every c there is n with σ(n) > cn such that no covering system with distinct moduli (StrictCoveringSystem ℤ) has all its moduli dividing n. 'm_i | n' is encoded as n ∈ (m_i), and distinct moduli is the right notion here. Formal proof linked.
